deploy.startCommand: sh -ec 'BID="${TGTC_SPEND_BUDGET_ID}-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)"; python -u -m tgtc_core migrate && python -u -m tgtc_core budget --budget-id "$BID" --expires-hours 24 --fantastic-requests 60 --fantastic-credits 3300 --apollo-requests 3000 --apollo-credits 1000 --anthropic-requests 1000 --anthropic-input-tokens 35000000 --anthropic-output-tokens 1024000 && python -u -m tgtc_core run-target --budget-id "$BID" --target 1000 --max-rounds 100 --max-items 10000 --i-understand-spend'
